change: Support both Cargo OUT_DIR layouts, create library destinations and retain DLLs beside test harnesses when Windows symlinks are unavailable. ONNX Runtime ABI and download digests remain unchanged. Parse distribution checksums identically with LF and CRLF checkouts. Accept a local archive under ORT_ARCHIVE for CI prefetch. When the cache is unwritable, use the libraries extracted under OUT_DIR. The existing distribution digest is still checked before extraction.
